visuals.advice: Add before/after simulator screenshots to the description (a GIF when the change affects motion or interaction: swipes, animations, sheets opening), or tick "No visible UI change" in the template. Editing the description re-runs this check.

readme-screenshots.source: the iOS Simulator shots CI's Screenshots and GIFs job took (mock library)

ciFixChecks: `npm run check` (what CI's unit job runs: lint, format check, typecheck, type coverage, depcruise, the native bridge check, tests with coverage; `npm run format` rewrites what the format check flags)

exempt.Dependabot Auto-Merge: Turns on auto-merge as a bot's PR opens: not a check, and nothing in it for a fix to answer.
exempt.PR visuals: Wants pictures in the PR description, which no code change gives (autofix skips its failure too).
exempt.README screenshots: Runs as a PR closes, when there's nothing left for autofix to do.
